rule.name: SpringImmutableBeans
rule.message: Make this field of a bean final, static fields too. Beans are shared singletons, so keep per-call state in locals.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Component') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Service') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Repository') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Controller') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ControllerAdvice') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice')]] /ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final')] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[(pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.PersistenceContext')) or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.PersistenceUnit') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.PersistenceUnit'))])]
